definition: An audio format specification that compresses digital audio without discarding any information needed to reconstruct the source samples.
entry_text: An audio format specification that compresses digital audio without discarding any information needed to reconstruct the source samples.
example: An archivist stores recordings in FLAC and can restore their original audio samples.
label: Free Lossless Audio Codec

sources.note: RFC 9639 defines a lossless format for digital audio. Lossless reconstruction refers to the encoded audio samples, not necessarily all metadata or container bytes from a source file.
